name: A non-LLM language model: logical inference on SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph and SignCraft, with language downstream of logic
asks:
In this session we want to go hard and ambitious to invest attention into realizing SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph, and SignCraft into the next-generation language model, artificial intelligence that we allude to in the readme, and keep approaching, such that we end up logical inference models, predication algebra models, all this stuff, a whole new class of AI that doesn't exist yet.

We need to use-and-improve our best theory on FCA, Curry-Howard-Lambek, tile coloring, lightcones, and weaving beads.

Use Fable to help you imagine the next-generation artificail intelligence, think of it like complex multicellular foam physics, abiotic digital organic simulation shit, use Sonnet to help you with the engineering.

nah fixing the packages to be real repo real packages on our registry, etc, is part of this: aim waaaay bigger than you did, get way more scifi read more about EROEI, distal bypass, think about the math yourself more to think about "ooooh predication chu space i get it"

okay so all of that work is actually great and necessary but still like totally misses it.

I mean literally

A non-LLM

language model

like did you even find our language engine, tokipona, etc.? conlang?

again what you're working on is useful, though you're trying to just do it way too thin but I am talking about something very very different, much more academic and serious and careful.

met-when.command: sh -c 'for k in FCA "Curry" tile lightcone bead; do grep -q -i "$k" services/engineering-services-section/services/computer-engineering-services-section/services/logical-inference-model/README.md || exit 1; done'

x-provenance.recorded-by: program-manager (bare-cedar-fog-claude, dispatched under the Leader standing direction of 2026-10-09)
x-provenance.basis: Opening prompt of the Leader on Bare Cedar Fog, carried as a requirement record by the board-requirement-intake skill. The raised-by field and asks are the Leader's own words; the requirements below are the program manager's EARS rendering of what those words ask, and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Group has a logical-inference model, with no statistical language-model weights, built on SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph and SignCraft, which produces language from its logical conclusions through the Group's language engine.

requirements.says: The inference model shall derive each conclusion by logical inference over SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph and SignCraft structures and by no statistical language-model weights.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "A non-LLM language model" and "logical inference models, predication algebra models".

requirements.says: The inference model shall produce natural-language output from its logical conclusions through the Group's language engine and its language fibers.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "did you even find our language engine, tokipona, etc.? conlang?"; the cascade note reads the regimes as algebra, logic, language, geometry, so language comes after logic.

requirements.says: The inference model shall build on the Group's theory of formal concept analysis, Curry-Howard-Lambek, tile colouring, lightcones and bead weaving, citing the held note for each.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "We need to use-and-improve our best theory on FCA, Curry-Howard-Lambek, tile coloring, lightcones, and weaving beads."

requirements.says: The inference model's packages shall each live in their own repository and be published on the Group's registry with their real dependencies.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "fixing the packages to be real repo real packages on our registry, etc, is part of this".

requirements.says: The inference model's design record shall be derived from the predication Chu space and the Group's mathematics and not from an existing language-model architecture.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "think about the math yourself more to think about 'ooooh predication chu space i get it'" and "a whole new class of AI that doesn't exist yet".

requirements.says: The inference model shall exchange conclusions with external large language models through the Group's inference engine, so that each supplements the other's intelligence.
requirements.rationale: The Leader, 2026-09-26: "we also do intend to build our own logical inference/language model, it's just that we then want to USE that model with LLMs to supplement the intelligence of both." The formal orchestration layer (typed term calculus, four-valued evidence logic, content-addressed witness logs) that audits calls to external LLMs is also being built, and is not the model itself.

conditions.says: The model's package exists and carries no weights or transformer dependency.
The package depends on the language engine package.
The SignCraft package resolves on the registry.

board-opening.context: The survey of 2026-10-08 states its own gap: it "did not yet read the house language engine itself (@lenticule-science/communicating and the language fibers: Toki Pona, English, Lakota, Latin, Mandarin; RelConLang; PTGAE; Panini; Horsetail)". The Leader's 20:44 message says that gap is exactly the point: the first run was "useful, though you're trying to just do it way too thin". The phrase "language downstream of logic" in the dispatch is the cascade note's reading (algebra, logic, language, geometry) and is carried as R2. The Leader asks for the work to be done "much more academic and serious and careful", with Fable for imagination and Sonnet for engineering; that staffing is not a requirement.
